newsitem.title: USA: Shoney shareholders set date for meeting.
newsitem.headline: Shoney shareholders set date for meeting.

text.p: The shareholders' committee of restaurant operator Shoney's Inc on Tuesday set September 25 as the date for a special meeting to vote on a proposal to remove the company's current board of directors.
Earlier in the month, the committee said an advisory organization had urged it to demand the meeting to consider replacing the board with its own slate of nominees.
The committee said in a statement that shareholders of record on August 11 will be entitled to vote on the proposal.
